Coding exercise 81eda11682a1299505dc. Language: Python.

Implement a production-quality asyncio TTL cache with async get_or_load, per-key single-flight loading, bounded LRU eviction, injectable monotonic clock, cancellation-safe loading, exception propagation, invalidate, and clear. Use only the standard library. Include unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase tests for concurrent callers, failed loaders, TTL expiry, cancellation and eviction.

Return an actual implementation and substantive tests, not a design sketch. Start with code. State the public API clearly in comments and handle edge cases explicitly. Keep all code self-contained. Include imports, type definitions, constructors, helper methods and tests. Prefer understandable correct code to clever tricks. Use concise comments where concurrency invariants matter. Do not use placeholder implementations, ellipses, TODOs, pseudocode, or third-party packages. Consider zero and negative capacity, repeated close, loader/task failures, canceled waiters, and resources released during cleanup. Avoid sleeping in tests when deterministic synchronization is possible. Explain any remaining tradeoffs after the code.

Use a distinct example key or task label example_0 in the tests.
